description: Methods of tools\e2e\data\wrapper-methods.json that no browser case proves, each with the reason; checked by tools\e2e\tests\method-coverage.spec.js (every method must be proven by a case of tests\helpers\method-cases\<group>.js, by an external proof, or listed here - never both - and every entry must still name an existing method). A known defect is flagged "knownDefect": true, its reason starts with KNOWN DEFECT and "defect" names the ticket and finding (for example "WAB-64 F1"); each such entry needs an expected-failure case (knownDefects of a case module) that references its key. A temporary entry with "pendingGroup" exempts every unproven method of that group until the group's case module exists; the spec prints it as "pending group <name>", and the group's agent removes it together with adding the module.
